caption: The drawing depicts two views of a sculpted object shaped like a horse’s head and neck, both placed on flat, oval-shaped bases. The horse heads are primarily dark brown with lighter brown and tan highlights, and include details such as carved ears, eyes, nostrils, mouth, and mane. Each head features a bridle rendered in tan and gray tones. The image on the left shows the horse head in a closed position, resembling a realistic bust. The image on the right shows the same head with the upper part hinged open, revealing an interior hollow space with a slot, indicating the object functions as a container, such as a coin bank. The inside of the horse’s mouth, visible in the open position, is colored in shades of pink and orange. The background is plain and cream-colored, emphasizing the object’s details and coloration.
title: Horse's Head Bank
